selection: Full Han utterance chunks 6..16 chars, exact canonical Quick code; SHA256(contrastive-v1:+filename+text), first1500/200/200; new validation/heldout exclude prior target substring in either direction
limitation: Public historical speech, not modern real-user chats. Conversation files were used before; new utterances only. Authored variants are correlated and are not measured use frequencies.

release_gate.note: Synthetic gains alone do not establish a major real-world improvement.

negative_selection: Up to ten incorrect displayed baseline candidates above gold (first ten if gold absent), plus one below gold for calibration. An unreachable exact-code gold is retained as a teacher positive; ranking alone cannot make it searchable.
baseline_margin_mode: Public baseline languageScore difference, excludes word segmentation and vocabulary priors; compared with ignore-offset fitting on validation only
